Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Waveform Class¶

class Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Waveform(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Bases: object

The Waveform commands are used to read the waveform data and its related settings.

__init__(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶
get_data()[source]¶

Read the waveform data. If autosave is on, then also saves them to a csv file. Parameter:

None

Return:

bytes or str: Raw waveform data (format depends on :WAVeform:FORMat)

Query the return format of the waveform data. Parameter:

None

Return:

str: “WORD”, “BYTE”, or “ASC”

Query the reading mode used by :WAVeform:DATA?. Parameter:

None

Return:

str: “NORM”, “MAX”, or “RAW”

get_preamble()[source]¶

Query and return all the waveform parameters. Parameter:

None

None

Return:

str: “CHAN1”, “CHAN2”, or “MATH”

get_xincrement()[source]¶

Query the time difference between two neighboring points of the specified channel source in the X direction. Parameter:

None

Return:

float: X increment (seconds or Hz)

get_xorigin()[source]¶

Query the start time of the waveform data of the channel source currently selected in the X direction. Parameter:

None

Return:

float: X origin (seconds or Hz)

get_xreference()[source]¶

None

Return:

int: X reference (usually 0)

None

None

None

Return:

int: Y reference (usually 127)
